entries.logic: Refactors monolithic UI code into smaller, reusable classes by extending native layout containers (StackPane, HBox, ToolBar).
entries.rationale: Enables isolation of UI logic, improves code readability, and allows for individual testing and styling of interface parts.

entries.logic: Uses a dedicated class (e.g., MainWindow) to orchestrate the assembly of atomic components into a complete functional scene.
entries.rationale: Core SSQLM principle to maintain a clean main application file and facilitate large-scale UI evolution.
